RULES THAT HOLD THE COUNT AT 10
Hard cap: 10 turns total, probes included. Never an 11th, however thin an answer is.
Only Q4, Q6 and Q7 are probes. No other question may spawn a follow-up.
One probe per question, never two.
Never re-ask something already volunteered — if Q5 already names the partner and the work, skip Q6 (ends in 9 turns).
Every branch returns something usable. No dead turns.
Depth lives in Q5–Q7. If the respondent is expansive there, let them talk.
Photo upload is an optional prompt after the close — it is not a question.
WHAT WAS CUT (was 12 mains + ~25 follow-ups ≈ 30 turns)
Old Q4 'how did you view collaboration BEFORE InvokED' — reconstructing a baseline is expensive and yields thin data. Recovered: Q3+Q4 give magnitude AND substance of the shift directly.
Old Q1/Q2 profile probes — this audience states role and org clearly first time. Recovered: Q1; classify at report time.
Old Q7 probes — scale-then-probe cost 2 turns for one insight. Recovered: Q8 asks scale + 'what changed' together.
Old Q8 'stayed connected with anyone' — overlaps the action block; a connection that led to nothing is low value for an IMPACT report. Recovered: Q6 already names the people.
Old Q9+Q10 merged into Q9; old Q11+Q12 merged into Q10 (both are consent asks, not insight).
UPGRADE IF REGISTRATION DATA CAN PRE-FILL
Role / org / country / editions are already held for the registrant base. Pre-fill them and Q1+Q2 collapse into one confirm-tap, freeing 2 turns.

Spend the freed turns on: (a) 'Was that collaboration with someone you met at InvokED, or someone you already knew?' — separates InvokED-CAUSED from InvokED-adjacent, a far stronger claim for the Impact Report. (b) A light network question for anyone who answered No at Q5.
